sections.title: What Is Lambda’s Cybersecurity Portal?
paragraphs: The Lambda’s Cybersecurity Portal is an integrated assessment tool exclusive to Victrix. This cybersecurity solution makes it easy to perform security audits of the strategic business elements you must protect. As a result, you'll benefit from tailored support for sound risk management.

The tool helps you better understand your security posture and gives you a clear view of what needs protection. The Cybersecurity Portal also addresses the specific needs of owners and managers of organizations of all kinds.
Here's how our cyber security tools can help you implement best practices in cybersecurity.
Law 25: Be Ready, Be Compliant with Lambda’s Cybersecurity Portal

Law 25 is inspired by the European Union's GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation). It follows the adoption of Law 64, entitled An Act to modernize legislative provisions respecting the protection of personal information.
Several provisions of Law 25 have been in force since September 22, 2022. Specifically, organizations operating in Quebec are required to:

• Nominate a person responsible for the protection of personal information 
  • Notify the Commission d'accès à l'information (CAI) and the affected individuals of any breach of confidentiality or unauthorized access, use or disclosure of personal information 
  • Keep an up-to-date record of all incidents over the past 5 years 
  • Take measures to reduce vulnerability and prevent future incidents

Other measures come into force on September 22, 2023 and September 22, 2024. These requirements will necessitate significant changes in terms of compliance and protection of personal information. With a security tool like our Lambda Cybersecurity Portal, you can be confident that you're ready to deal with these changes as effectively as possible.
